subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group and topic session keys include normalized bot account/app identity by default, and how should existing unscoped group sessions migrate?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent fix changes persisted session identity and bot/account isolation semantics that can affect history, bindings, and security boundaries.

options.title: Account-scope group sessions
options.body: Include normalized account or app identity in Feishu group/topic session keys, add migration or doctor repair for existing unscoped sessions, and require focused multi-bot proof.

options.title: Keep shared group sessions
options.body: Document same-group multi-bot Feishu sessions as unsupported or opt-in and accept the current identity-sharing behavior until a broader design lands.

options.title: Defer behind mention identity
options.body: Resolve the app-scoped Feishu @mention identity tracker first, then revisit session isolation after target-bot admission is proven.

recommendation.title: Account-scope group sessions
recommendation.body: Include normalized account or app identity in Feishu group/topic session keys, add migration or doctor repair for existing unscoped sessions, and require focused multi-bot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-source signal on the affected route/session-key files and recent Feishu review context.
